How to Use
Clean and dry the area before waxing
Apply a suitable pre-wax product to the skin if required
Warm the roll-on cartridge according to the wax heater instructions
Hold the cartridge at approximately a 45-degree angle to the skin
Apply the wax in a gentle, even stroke in the direction of hair growth
Place a suitable waxing strip over the applied wax
Press the strip firmly onto the wax
Remove the strip using your usual waxing technique
Clean any remaining wax from the skin after hair removal

Storage & Care
Store the wax cartridge horizontally
Keep away from direct heat sources
Avoid exposing the product to excessive temperatures
If the wax becomes excessively soft or sticky due to high temperature, store it in a refrigerator as appropriate
Keep the product sealed until ready for use

Safety Information
For external use only
Perform a patch test before first use
Do not apply to damaged, irritated or broken skin
Avoid contact with eyes and sensitive areas
Do not leave hair removal wax on the skin longer than necessary
Check the wax temperature before applying to skin
Stop use if significant irritation or discomfort occurs
Keep out of reach of children
Follow the instructions of your wax heater and waxing strips
